stores.export: Account and travel-profile fields; authentication secrets and session material are excluded
stores.deletion: Sessions are revoked immediately; application rows and the Supabase identity are hard-deleted within 24 hours
stores.backupDeletion: No later than 31 days after confirmation

stores.activeRetention: Account lifetime, subject to per-feature expiry constraints
stores.export: Canonical JSON plus trip CSV, itinerary JSON, assistant records, and source references
stores.deletion: Cascade-deleted with the owning account within 24 hours
stores.backupDeletion: No later than 31 days after confirmation

stores.activeRetention: Share links expire within 180 days; offline metadata follows the account
stores.export: Share and offline-package metadata only; link secrets and cached package payloads are excluded
stores.deletion: Server grants are revoked immediately; local data is cleared on the confirming device and denied after the next authorization check
stores.backupDeletion: Server records no later than 31 days; browser eviction timing outside the confirming device is user-agent controlled

stores.activeRetention: Service lifetime until normal queue cleanup
stores.export: User-facing generation records are exported through their owning trip or assistant record
stores.deletion: Active jobs are cancelled and application and queue payloads, results, requester IDs, subject IDs, and errors are scrubbed immediately
stores.backupDeletion: No later than 31 days after confirmation

stores.activeRetention: Single-purpose grant for 23 hours; artifact expires and is physically pruned within 24 hours
stores.export: Encrypted ZIP containing the versioned account export
stores.deletion: All outstanding grants and ciphertext are deleted immediately on confirmation
stores.backupDeletion: No later than 31 days after confirmation

stores.activeRetention: Opaque subject tombstone for 31 days; receipt for 12 calendar months
stores.deletion: The receipt contains only policy version, deadlines, step states, and normalized failure codes; no account or content linkage
stores.backupDeletion: Tombstone expires after 31 days; receipt expires after 12 calendar months

stores.activeRetention: Audit events 12 months; AI telemetry 90 days; raw logs and traces at most 30 days; aggregate metrics at most 395 days
stores.export: Account-linked audit action metadata is included; aggregate and evaluation telemetry is excluded
stores.deletion: Account linkage is removed while content-free operational evidence follows its fixed expiry
stores.backupDeletion: No later than 31 days after each record's expiry

stores.export: Only licensed source references connected to exported account content
stores.deletion: Not deleted with an account because records are not account-owned; quarantine payloads must not contain user data
stores.backupDeletion: Provider contract and operational backup policy
